reviewer: Codex self-review; no independent reviewer was available

reference_conditioning.note: The board was supplied through the built-in imagegen reference-image input. The tool returned no signal confirming whether it conditioned on that image.

card_preview.readability: The primary hook, comparison line, support line, and subjects remain recognizable at the actual blog-card review size.

realism.notes: The scene reads as premium commercial 3D product rendering, not a flat illustration or infographic.

material_quality.notes: Corrugated cartons show convincing paper texture and seams; the timber pallets have visible grain and dimensional construction.

lighting_and_depth.notes: Warm key highlights and restrained teal edge light give both loads clear depth; pallet and carton contact shadows feel grounded.

composition_and_scale.notes: Both loads are large, similarly scaled, clearly separated, and readable in the renderer-owned right-side illustration zone. The left text zone remains clear.

transparency_and_clutter.notes: The source PNG has transparency. No full-frame matte, floor, haze, decorative props, generated text, or branding is visible in the final card.

family_consistency.notes: The card uses the approved dark-teal background, mint and white typography, and restrained commercial packaging scene consistent with the approved board and the bottle regression example.

article_claim_integrity.notes: The illustration is conceptual and contains no exact numeric labels, vendor interface, or claim of exact solver geometry.

decision: Owner approved this visually reviewed candidate for production integration.
